audience: engineering and on-call teams that investigate services in Honeycomb

useCases.title: Run a query on a dataset
useCases.text: List the datasets of the Environment, then run a query with calculations and breakdowns and read the summary rows.

useCases.title: Check columns before a query
useCases.text: List the columns of a dataset with their types, and read a saved query to reuse its settings.

useCases.title: Review triggers and SLOs
useCases.text: List the alert triggers and SLOs of a dataset, then read the budget figures of one SLO.

useCases.title: Read boards for a service
useCases.text: List the boards of the Environment, then read one board with its contents.

useCases.title: Mark a deploy on a dataset graph
useCases.text: Create a deploy marker with a message and a time, so the graph shows when a release shipped. Then list the markers.
